newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Hub Power gain 3.92 percent.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Hub Power gain 3.92 percent.

text.p: Pakistan blue chip Hub Power Co Ltd jumped 1.15 rupees, or 3.92 percent, to 30.50 on Thursday on heavy buying triggered by the recent devaluation of rupee against dollar, brokers said.
Turnover of the Hub Power reached 3,248,500 shares by midsession as it emerged as volume leader.
"All the GDR (Global Depositary Receipt) related scrips have gained due to the rupee devaluation," dealer Ali Asghar said.
"The appreciation of dollar (against Pakistani rupee) give investors a better spread if they buy the stock from local market." -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
